title: NAILS recover --json
description: Machine-readable recover envelope (contract version 2): one document with schema_version, command, ok, and either data (what an interrupted activation left and what was removed; a mount left below /run/nextroot is exit 7) or error. The envelope frame and error body are strict; the data is this command's own payload. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9.
